title: CounterSketch desktop UI and workflow parity inventory
scope: Static decompiled installer-studio baseline; desktop-xaml is supplemental recovered markup, not asserted same build.
limitations: Source-backed static inventory; no target execution, downloads, or external service calls.
installer-studio is the baseline. desktop-xaml supplemental markup may represent another build; name matches are not proof of equivalent runtime wiring.

All declarations and selected directory surfaces are inventoried mechanically; grouped behavior rows are reviewed at entrypoint/target-body level. Not every infrastructure handler is an independently implemented user feature.

Unassigned commands, empty bodies and unmatched bindings are explicitly retained; runtime control creation, data-driven variants, profile gates and dynamic reflection cannot be fully proven by these inventories.
Source evidence line numbers refer to decompiled files, not original source or disassembly.
